items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Terminology 52:1
items.html: It is the number of days needed to correct one vessel during the time of pregnancy. For there are seven vessels, and their correction extends over twelve months, which are three hundred and sixty and a half days, so it is found to be fifty-one and a half days for each vessel. (Item 7).
